claim: Per-letter unitary operators trained on S5 words that never contain the ordered transitions (s1,s2) or (s3,s4) handle those transitions exactly: all 12 of 40 runs that learned the seen words scored 1.0 at L=160 on words full of the unseen transitions; a transition-memorising null that also learned the seen words (13 runs) stayed at chance (<= 0.0265) on them.
limits: Composition is architectural (product of per-letter matrices); training succeeds on only 12 of 40 seeds; one group, one width, one pair of held-out transitions; x86_64 only.
